contracts.boundary: Real pinned Pi TUI offers a concise tool-generated summary without raw rule/model JSON or duplicate equivalent source/effective lists, or a user-selected sequential exact review before one guarded write. Summary explicitly identifies classifier disablement and wholesale rule removal; layered source changes are distinguished from unchanged effective behavior. Ordinary and narrow viewports show navigable bounded summaries; exact review displays the full 6,000-character value and suffix. Summary Apply is explicit; exact-view Apply is gated to its final rendered page. Resize and cancellation fail closed.
contracts.assertions: Unit tests check concise summary counts, absence of raw rule/model values, accurate source/effective deltas, and a deterministic added-tier candidate retaining existing tiers/rules/classifier/fallbacks. Skill packaging test checks explicit preserve-and-compare guidance and states it is advisory, not model enforcement. Real Pi PTY checks concise summary content for a 16-rule removal without JSON values, pool/fallback counts, bounded page counts and visible controls at ordinary/narrow widths, and a layered workspace edit masked by project policy; the latter reports source changes and unchanged effective behavior. It also selects exact review, confirms early exact Apply writes nothing, verifies the entire 6,000-character value across rendered pages, cancels safely, applies exact after resize reset, and separately applies from summary. Isolated Pi fault copy suppresses classifier summary and must fail the real-Pi display assertion. Current Pi's `ctx.ui.editor` edits supplied text via a temporary editor file; it has no API to open the saved config path. No post-apply editor action is offered because editing a copy would need a validated, re-approved write/reload roundtrip.

boundaryTest.name: requires complete paged approval in real pinned Pi across viewport resize

invariant.name: retains existing tiers, rules, classifier, and fallbacks when adding a tier

fault.name: detects a faulty summary that hides classifier disablement in an isolated Pi copy
